description: This file defines a class GPTImageGenerationConfig that extends a base image generation configuration class. It includes methods for getting supported OpenAI image generation parameters, mapping parameters, and transforming responses from the image generation API, with logging support.

classes.name: GPTImageGenerationConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for OpenAI gpt-image-1 image generation, providing parameter support and response transformation methods.
